method: Whole-view comparison of each panorama (1148x1063, pitched up) with its dry render at the same size from the same camera at 90 degree vertical field of view; positions read on each feature's own row.
note: The house stands free of its neighbours: the pass 66 panorama at number 50 (its camera already fixed) shows a fenced gap of about 0.5 m to number 49 and puts the plinth ends at x 134.8 and about 150.0, at the same base height; the district outline runs on to 152.04 over a fenced yard gate, which is released as open ground. The close panorama facing the house was resected on those two corners and reads the pilasters and windows; its pilaster edges agree with the view along the street within 0.15 m. Heights are taken with the base row 0.25 m below the first assumption (cameras 2.55 m). The roof pitch, the ridge and the rear wall are estimates.
